name: Alarm Logs in Packaging Industry
summary: A sequence of timestamped alarm events collected from 20 industrial packaging machines.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the alarm was recorded.

attributes.name: serial
attributes.description: Anonymized identifier of the machine that generated the alarm.

notes: The alarm-code distribution is highly imbalanced.
Cross-machine evaluation requires group-aware splitting to prevent leakage from the same machine.
citation: Dalle Pezze, D. et al. (2021), “ALARM LOGS IN PACKAGING INDUSTRY (ALPI)”, Mendeley Data, V1.
